mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the joint and bones was most worthwhile because the explanation showed why the arm needs opposing muscle pulls and defined tendons as bands attaching muscle to bone.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual muscle fittings felt repetitive because the first result had already explained both groups before they were fitted.

surprise.text: The first result explained both muscle groups and their combined action before I added either one. The explanation made sense, but its timing anticipated the later actions.

arbitrary.text: Neither fitting felt arbitrary: each filled a named slot for a pull in one direction. The menu showed that both were compatible, so I did not discover their compatibility myself.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how the arm gets supplies and instructions, although this chapter's later fittings offered few meaningful decisions.
